blocksHtml:
• Description
  • Product Table
  • Video
  • Review

The Wi-Tek WI-POE11S-48V PoE Splitter is a compact and efficient device designed to convert Power over Ethernet (PoE) into separate DC power and data output. It supports IEEE 802.3af/at PoE standards and can deliver up to 30W power, making it ideal for powering non-PoE devices such as IP cameras, wireless access points, routers, and other network equipment.


This splitter features 1× 100Mbps PoE input port and provides a stable 12V 2A DC output, allowing devices without built-in PoE capability to be powered through a PoE network cable. By separating the data and power signals, the device enables flexible installation and reduces the need for additional power adapters.


The Wi-Tek WI-POE11S-48V is widely used in CCTV systems, wireless networking setups, and surveillance installations, providing a reliable and cost-effective solution for PoE power distribution.


With its compact design, stable performance, and easy plug-and-play installation, this PoE splitter is an excellent choice for expanding PoE network applications in homes, offices, and business environments.


Key Features


  • Supports IEEE 802.3af/at PoE standards
  • 1 × 100Mbps PoE input port
  • DC Output: 12V 2A
  • Maximum 30W PoE power input
  • Separates power and data from Ethernet cable
  • Plug-and-play installation
  • Compact and lightweight design
  • Ideal for IP cameras, routers, and access points
